ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) across approximately 75% of the visible surface, contrasted by a low-intensity (black) central vertical band and peduncle area.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small, discrete low-intensity circular focal spots distributed non-uniformly across the high-intensity white regions of both lobes.
